sparql_tries.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?componentName WHERE { ?campaign a rc:RecallCampaign ; rc:campaignNumber "10V388000" ; rc:affectsComponent ?component . ?component rc:name ?componentName . } ORDER BY ?componentName

  ?comp a rc:Component ; rc:name "SERVICE BRAKES, HYDRAULIC:ANTILOCK/TRACTION CONTROL/ELECTRONIC LIMITED SLIP:CONTROL UNIT/MODULE" .
  ?campaign a rc:RecallCampaign ; rc:affectsComponent ?comp ; rc:affects ?variant .

sparql_tries.sparql:
SELECT DISTINCT ?modelName WHERE {
  ?tc rc:affects ?tv ; rc:affectsComponent ?comp .
  ?tv rc:ofModel ?tm . ?tm rc:name "TELLURIDE" ; rc:ofMake ?km . ?km rc:name "KIA" .
  ?comp skos:broader ?parent .
  ?gc rc:affects ?gv ; rc:affectsComponent ?comp .
  ?gv rc:ofModel ?gm . ?gm rc:ofMake ?gmk . ?gmk rc:name "GENESIS" .
  ?gm rc:name ?modelName .
} ORDER BY ?modelName

SELECT ?modelName ?makeName (COUNT(DISTINCT ?campaign) AS ?campaignCount) WHERE { ?campaign a rc:RecallCampaign ; rc:affects ?variant . ?variant rc:ofModel ?model . ?model rc:name ?modelName . OPTIONAL { ?model rc:ofMake ?make . ?make rc:name ?makeName } } GROUP BY ?modelName ?makeName ORDER BY DESC(?campaignCount) LIMIT 10

SELECT ?campaignNumber ?potentiallyAffected WHERE { ?c a rc:RecallCampaign ; rc:parkOutside true ; rc:campaignNumber ?campaignNumber ; rc:potentiallyAffected ?potentiallyAffected . } ORDER BY DESC(?potentiallyAffected) LIMIT 1
SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?campaign) AS ?count) WHERE { ?campaign a rc:RecallCampaign ; rc:initiatedBy ?initiator . FILTER(CONTAINS(UCASE(STR(?initiator)), "ODI")) }

SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?year) AS ?yearCount) WHERE { ?make a rc:Make ; rc:name "HYUNDAI" . ?model a rc:VehicleModel ; rc:ofMake ?make ; rc:name "SONATA" . ?variant rc:ofModel ?model ; rc:modelYear ?year . ?campaign a rc:RecallCampaign ; rc:affects ?variant . }
